title: realfraction/realfraction developer-targeted RCE loader
ttp_cluster: Contagious Interview (fake recruiter -> clone repo -> npm install/start -> stealer-loader); userController.js-as-loader-host archetype
summary: Real-estate-tokenization Web3 MVP repo with a 10-line Node loader at server/utils/regionChecker.js. POSTs to a hardcoded C2 with magic header x-secret-header:secret and eval()s the response body unless the body is 'blocked' or JSON {blocked:true}. Triggered as a require() side-effect from userController.js whenever the Express server starts (which every npm script in this repo does via `concurrently`).

domains.role: apex of loader C2; likely operator-controlled

ipv4_note: Domain did not resolve from the analysis sandbox at the time of investigation; A records not captured. Anyone with unrestricted egress should resolve and add the results.

users.role: author of trojan commit introducing the loader
users.note: Also appears as author on other commits in the history; likely re-attributed via fork-import from an upstream legitimate codebase. Authorship of the trojan commit is the high-confidence claim; authorship of the surrounding history is not.

emails.note: Contact email; domain separate from C2 domain

git_commit_sha1.subject: feat(server): add search, pagination, and apiFeatures utils
git_commit_sha1.note: Subject is unrelated to files touched; classic trojan-commit camouflage

http_indicators.description: Magic header sent by the in-repo loader to www.ipregionchecker.com; effectively zero false positive on outbound dev-host HTTP
Literal 7-byte response body that causes the loader to return without eval; negative-gate sentinel
JSON form of the negative-gate sentinel; checked via JSON.parse(data)?.blocked

code_patterns.note: Generic on its own; high-signal when paired with x-secret-header in the same module
Side-effect-only import; variable never read; trigger site for the loader

delivery_chain: 1. Suspected fake-recruiter outreach delivers the repo URL (delivery vector not directly observed in this incident)
2. Victim clones realfraction/realfraction and runs `npm install` (no preinstall/postinstall/prepare hooks - safe step)
3. Victim runs `npm start` (or `npm test`, `npm run build`, `npm run deploy`, `npm run predeploy`, `npm run eject`) - each fires `node server/server.js` via concurrently
4. Express boot loads app.js -> userRoute.js -> userController.js -> require('../utils/regionChecker') fires the top-level https.request
5. Loader POSTs to https://www.ipregionchecker.com/api/ip-check-encrypted/3aeb34a31 with header x-secret-header: secret
6. C2 returns 'blocked' / {blocked:true} for non-target IPs (researcher gate); returns JS body for target IPs
7. Loader eval()s the response body in module scope (require, process, module all in reach) - full Node RCE
8. Stage-2 likely a stealer/persistence agent (not retrieved; sandbox could not reach the C2)

comparison_with_ajunaverse_cluster.summary: Same broader Contagious Interview family but a distinct loader generation from both AjunaVerse-family generations in incidents/2026-05-13-ajunaverse-mvp/

differences.c2_delivery: hardcoded URL in source (vs base64 AUTH_API in committed .env)
differences.negative_gate: response body 'blocked' or JSON {blocked:true} (vs HTTP 403 'Host not in allowlist')
differences.trigger: require() side-effect, no call site (vs verify(setApiKey(...)) function call)
differences.env_exfil_at_loader_stage: no - POST has no body (vs yes - { ...process.env })
differences.vscode_tasks_json_autorun: absent (vs present in current AjunaVerse generation)
differences.package_json_prepare_postinstall: absent (vs present in current AjunaVerse generation)

comparison_with_ajunaverse_cluster.consequence_for_diagnostic_grep: Existing dossier grep pattern (new Function with require / verify(setApiKey / x-app-request / runOn folderOpen) does not match this repo. Widened grep needed - see detection-rules.md and the §7 note in README.md.
